data.one_liner: A plugin to call native platform APIs for alert sounds and dialogs.
data.what_it_does: Bridges native platform alert APIs to play alert sounds and display native alert dialogs across iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_when: You need native operating system alert dialogs and sounds
Targeting desktop platforms where native dialog styling is required
avoid_when: You want fully customizable Flutter-rendered widget dialogs that match Material or Cupertino themes precisely
You require complex custom form widgets inside the alert dialog
strengths: Uses native platform APIs for authentic look, feel, and sound
Cross-platform support covering iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Icon styles are not available on iOS and Android
Localization of standard buttons requires platform-specific steps
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and run pub get.
